corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Printed pp.6-7 executive summary, pp.14-16 section 2.2.1 and pp.42-44 chapter 5: AI/ML in motor and health insurance, fairness, explainability and governance. Health-insurance data and pricing scope is explicit.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: PDF imprint supplies year 2019 only; April2019 in its filename is not issue-date evidence. The contemporaneous release establishes exact publication despite a later catalogue date of 19 June 2019. Publications Office is the printed publisher, while EIOPA is author and official host/releasing authority. Cover photograph credit: istock.com/SusanneB (PDF p.2), not a report author. Empirical sample is 222 insurers/intermediaries from 28 jurisdictions, not a census of the entire EU insurance industry. Concept coding and policy-group assignment remain uncompleted; empty arrays do not establish absence.
